description: This file defines the 'Online' model class for the Opencart admin report module. The class provides methods to retrieve online customer records and their totals from the database, with filtering options for IP and customer name.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: A model class in the Opencart admin report namespace responsible for fetching online customer data and totals.

methods.name: getOnline
methods.description: Retrieves a list of online customer sessions from the database based on optional filtering criteria, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalOnline
methods.description: Returns the total count of online customer sessions that match the given filters.
